newsitem.title: HONG KONG: First Shanghai issues 86 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: First Shanghai issues 86 mln new shares.

text.p: First Shanghai Investments Ltd said on Tuesday it would issue 86.49 million new shares to its controlling shareholder International Enterprises Investment Co Ltd, raising net proceeds of HK$61 million.

First Shanghai said its parent would place 55.84 million existing shares, or a 9.14 percent stake, to independent investors at HK$0.73 per share before buying the new shares at the net placement price.
On completion of the deal, International Enterprises Investment's stake would be unchanged at 35.44 percent.
About HK$30 million of the net proceeds would be used for possible acquisitions of assets from the parent company and the remainder would be used to repay bank borrowings, First Shanghai said.
Shares of First Shanghai fell HK$0.04 to HK$0.79.
